workouts.name: Steady Row
workouts.description: Continuous rowing at a conversational aerobic effort. Useful when cycling or outdoor running is unavailable.

workouts.name: Steady Swim
workouts.description: Continuous or interval-based easy swimming with generous rest as needed. Focus on sustainable effort and technique.

workouts.name: Row + Swim Combo
workouts.description: A low-impact mixed aerobic session that works well for travel or island weekends.

workouts.name: Elliptical Aerobic
workouts.description: Steady low-impact aerobic work. Keep resistance and cadence at a sustainable level.

workouts.name: Indoor Bike
workouts.description: Indoor substitute for an outdoor bike day. Keep most of the session conversational.

workouts.name: Long Hike / Adventure Walk
workouts.description: Sustained walking or hiking can replace a long low-impact endurance day when terrain and conditions are appropriate.

workouts.name: Incline Treadmill Walk
workouts.description: Brisk incline walking for aerobic work with less impact than running. Adjust grade to keep effort controlled.

workouts.name: Travel Full-Body Strength
workouts.description: A simplified full-body session using available dumbbells, bodyweight, or hotel-gym machines while preserving squat, hinge, push, and pull patterns.
